description: The release lines of each federated source database that Spice supports and tests: LTS lines only. PostgreSQL has no LTS label and supports every major for five years, so each supported major is listed; MySQL lists its LTS tracks (no innovation releases); MongoDB lists its major releases (no rapid or minor releases). Keep each list in ascending order: the last entry is the integration suite's default, and CI runs the suite again on every other entry (.github/workflows/integration.yml). Remove a line once it passes end_of_life.
